messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Good afternoon everyone!

As we get ready to start the fall semester, the R group will be holding a planning meeting this Friday, August 23rd at noon in Stone 3208 or via zoom.

If you have any ideas or requests for things to cover this semester, or just want to join us for the fun, please be sure to stop by.


Join Zoom Meeting
https://fsu.zoom.us/j/97381084243

I hope to see you this Friday!



Kari Roberts

Director of Strategic Planning and Assessment

Division of Student Affairs

Florida State University

313 Westcott Building

Tallahassee, FL 32306-1340

________________________________

Subject: [M&S] R group this Friday!


Good afternoon all!

The R group will meet this Friday on zoom at 12:00.  We will have an open session this week, so if you have an R project you are working on, come show it off and/or get some help troubleshooting anything you need.

You can access the zoom here:
https://fsu.zoom.us/j/95091562161<https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffsu.zoom.us%2Fj%2F95091562161&data=05%7C02%7Cepls-r-users%40lists.fsu.edu%7C2bef0a8fc2e944d50d4e08dcc08252df%7Ca36450ebdb0642a78d1b026719f701e3%7C0%7C0%7C638596913158996541%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=S5UJcwZZmyWNJOviU8zMNaa6bgwEiRgaXD5dnohKh5o%3D&reserved=0>
